note: DT.5l: entries and runtime-invoked members no source line calls, each beside a look-alike that must stay dead or unbound. Go: a top-level `func init()` is an entry (a NamedEntry gated to .go files: a TS or Python function named init stays an ordinary name, as does a Go METHOD named init); String / MarshalJSON of a live Point are invoked through fmt.Stringer / json.Marshaler, signature-checked (Point::Scan() bool is no sql.Scanner), never for a dead owner (Orphan::String); a live Queue's lone Len() int stays dead (sort.Interface is Len + Less + Swap). TS: getTranslation of a class implementing @jsverse/transloco's TranslocoLoader, and handleError of an @angular/core ErrorHandler, read off the class's unbound heritage ref plus the library its file imports; FakeLoader (imports the library, no heritage) and admin's LocalLoader (imports the library, implements an in-repo look-alike interface the ref binds to) stay dead. Dart: onRequest of a dio Interceptor subclass; Logger::onRequest (imports dio, no heritage) stays dead. Kotlin: `class MainActivity : FlutterActivity()` under an io.flutter import is a ROLE COMPONENT entry; Shadow (FlutterActivity imported from elsewhere) is not. Swift: an `@main` type is a ROLE COMPONENT entry and UIKit calls its application(..); SceneHelper (no @main) stays dead. Python: a call in `if __name__ == "__main__":` is the MODULE's, and the MODULE carries an ENTRYPOINT cell (source main_guard); a def inside the guard is not walked; a bare call binds the caller's own nested def before a module-level one (LEGB), so the module-level double loses its only caller; `if name == "__main__":` is no guard. Liveness is not graph content, so the rows are asserted by engine/tests/dead_runtime.rs; this key pins the edges and cells the fix adds and that no hop is stored as an edge. Tag 0.5.2-complete (debug CLI, `glia gaps go --with web --with admin --with mobile --with scripts --category dead_symbol`): 30 dead_symbol rows, `[live] profile=code entrypoints=4 (kind=2 role=2 declared=0) owners=2 implementers=0 invoked=3 reached=19/80`.
